meanings.usage: 指从事科学研究的人，可数名词
指一个人的整个生命时间
常用于描述正在运作的事物
指仔细观察并研究某事物
不及物动词，用于描述火山爆发
形容力量强大、破坏性的事物
可数名词，口语中常简称为 photo

meanings.meaning: 液体（指液态物质，与 solid（固体）和 gas（气体）相对）

meanings.usage: 指用工具测量温度、大小等
指冷热程度，常与 measure 搭配使用
指从四面八方围住某物

meanings.meaning: alive 做定语时一定要放在被修饰词后面

examples.en: He has often risked his life in this way.
examples.zh: 他经常以这种方式冒着生命危险。

examples.en: Tazieff was able to set up his camp very close to the volcano.
examples.zh: 塔齐耶夫得以在离火山很近的地方搭建营地。

examples.en: Tazieff managed to escape just in time.
examples.zh: 塔齐耶夫设法及时逃脱了。

examples.en: He was able to return two days later.
He waited until the volcano became quiet.
Tazieff has often risked his life in this way.
examples.zh: 塔齐耶夫经常以这种方式冒着生命危险。

examples.en: A river of liquid rock was coming towards him.
He has been able to tell us more about active volcanoes than any man alive.
examples.zh: 他告诉我们的关于活火山的情况比任何在世的人都多。

examples.en: He managed to take a number of brilliant photographs.
examples.zh: 他设法拍摄了一些精彩的照片。

examples.en: He managed to climb into the mouth of Kituro.
examples.zh: 他设法爬进了基图罗火山口。

grammar.title: 一般过去时 (Simple Past Tense)
grammar.definition: 表示过去发生的动作或存在的状态，通常与表示过去的时间状语连用 用于叙述过去发生的事情，描述已经完成的动作或状态

examples.en: In 1948, he went to Lake Kivu in the Congo.

examples.zh: 后来他将其命名为基图罗。

grammar.title: 过去进行时 (Past Continuous Tense)
grammar.definition: 表示过去某个时刻正在进行的动作 用于描述过去正在发生的动作，常与 when/while 等连用

examples.en: A river of liquid rock was coming towards him.

grammar.title: 过去完成时 (Past Perfect Tense)
grammar.structure: 主语 + had + 过去分词
grammar.definition: 表示过去某一时间之前已经完成的动作，即'过去的过去' 用于描述在过去的某个动作之前已经完成的动作

examples.en: He noticed that a river of liquid rock was coming towards him, but he had already taken many photos.
examples.zh: 他注意到熔岩正向他涌来，但他已经拍了很多照片。

patterns.pattern: 主语 + has spent + 时间/精力 + doing something

original.en: Haroun Tazieff has spent his lifetime studying active volcanoes.
original.zh: 哈伦·塔齐耶夫一生都在研究活火山。

imitations.en: She has spent her life teaching students.
He has spent ten years writing this novel.
imitations.zh: 他花了十年写这本小说。

patterns.pattern: 主语 + was/were + able to + 动词原形

original.en: Tazieff was able to set up his camp very close to the volcano.
original.zh: 塔齐耶夫得以在离火山很近的地方搭建营地。

imitations.en: I was able to finish the work on time.
She was able to speak three languages.

patterns.pattern: 主语 + managed to + 动词原形

original.en: Tazieff managed to escape just in time.
original.zh: 塔齐耶夫设法及时逃脱了。

imitations.en: He managed to pass the exam.
We managed to find the way home.
imitations.zh: 我们设法找到了回家的路。

patterns.pattern: It threatened to + 动词原形

original.en: It threatened to surround him completely.
original.zh: 它（熔岩）威胁要将他完全包围。

imitations.en: The rain threatened to ruin our picnic.
imitations.zh: 雨可能会毁掉我们的野餐。

imitations.en: The storm threatened to destroy the town.
imitations.zh: 暴风雨可能会摧毁这个城镇。

lines.en: Haroun Tazieff, the Polish scientist, has spent his lifetime studying active volcanoes and deep caves in all parts of the world.
In 1948, he went to Lake Kivu in the Congo to observe a new volcano which he later named Kituro.
lines.zh: 塔捷耶夫花了毕生的精力来研究世界各地的活火山和深洞。

lines.en: Tazieff was able to set up his camp very close to the volcano while it was erupting violently .
lines.zh: 1948年他去了刚果的基伍湖，对一座后来被他命名为基图罗的新火山进行观察。

lines.en: Though he managed to take a number of brilliant photographs, he could not stay near the volcano for very long.
lines.zh: 当火山正在猛烈地喷发时，塔捷耶夫有办法把帐篷搭在离它非常近的地方。

lines.en: He noticed that a river of liquid rock was coming towards him.
lines.zh: 尽管他设法拍了一些十分精彩的照片，但他却不能在火山附近停留太长的时间。

lines.en: It threatened to surround him completely , but Tazieff managed to escape just in time.
lines.zh: 他发现有一股岩浆正向他流过来，眼看就要将他团团围住，但塔捷耶夫还是设法及时逃离了。

lines.en: He waited until the volcano became quiet and he was able to return two days later.
lines.zh: 他等到火山平静下来，两天以后又返回去。

lines.en: This time, he managed to climb into the mouth of Kituro so that he could take photographs and measure temperatures.
lines.zh: 这次他设法爬进了基图罗火山口，以便能拍摄照片和测试温度。

lines.en: Tazieff has often risked his life in this way.
lines.zh: 塔捷耶夫经常冒这样的生命危险。

lines.en: He has been able to tell us more about active volcanoes than any man alive.
lines.zh: 他能告诉我们的有关活火山的情况比任何在世的人都要多。

questions.q: Why does Tazieff risk his life like this?
questions.zh: 塔捷耶夫为什么这样冒着生命危险？
questions.a: Because he wants to study active volcanoes and tell us more about them than any man alive — he even climbed into the mouth of Kituro to take photographs and measure temperatures.
questions.aZh: 因为他是研究活火山的科学家，想获得第一手资料；他甚至爬进基图罗火山口拍照、测温。

questions.q: In 1948, where did Tazieff go and what did he name the new volcano?
questions.zh: 1948 年塔捷耶夫去了哪里？他给那座新火山起了什么名字？
questions.a: He went to Lake Kivu in the Congo to observe a new volcano, which he later named Kituro.
questions.aZh: 他去了刚果的基伍湖观察一座新火山，后来把它命名为基图罗。

questions.q: Why could he not stay near the volcano for very long?
questions.zh: 他为什么不能在火山附近停留太久？
questions.a: Because he noticed a river of liquid rock coming towards him; it threatened to surround him completely, so he managed to escape just in time.
questions.aZh: 因为他发现一股岩浆正向他流过来，眼看就要把他完全围住，他只好及时逃离。

questions.q: What did he manage to do when he returned two days later?
questions.zh: 两天后他返回时，设法做了什么？
questions.a: He managed to climb into the mouth of Kituro so that he could take photographs and measure temperatures.
questions.aZh: 他设法爬进了基图罗火山口，以便能拍照和测量温度。

questions.q: Why does the text use 'was able to' / 'managed to' instead of 'could'?
questions.zh: 课文为什么用 was able to / managed to，而不用 could？
questions.a: Because could only states ability and does not say the action was achieved; was able to / managed to tell us that one particular past action was successfully done, and manage to adds the idea 'in spite of great difficulty'.
questions.aZh: 因为 could 只表示有能力，不说明做成了；was able to 强调过去某一次确实成功，managed to 强调克服困难后做成。
questions.hint: 见第 3 句与第 6 句。

translation:
波兰科学家哈罗恩。
塔捷耶夫花了毕生的精力来研究世界各地的活火山和深洞。
1948年他去了刚果的基伍湖，对一座后来被他命名为基图罗的新火山进行观察。
当火山正在猛烈地喷发时，塔捷耶夫有办法把帐篷搭在离它非常近的地方。
尽管他设法拍了一些十分精彩的照片，但他却不能在火山附近停留太长的时间。
他发现有一股岩浆正向他流过来，眼看就要将他团团围住，但塔捷耶夫还是设法及时逃离了。
他等到火山平静下来，两天以后又返回去。
这次他设法爬进了基图罗火山口，以便能拍摄照片和测试温度。
塔捷耶夫经常冒这样的生命危险。
他能告诉我们的有关活火山的情况比任何在世的人都要多。
title: Volcanoes
subtitle: 火山

lead.question: 塔捷耶夫为何甘愿冒着生命危险，一次次靠近正在猛烈喷发的火山？
lead.warmup: 火山喷发时岩浆奔流、浓烟冲天，普通人唯恐避之不及，波兰科学家哈罗恩·塔捷耶夫却偏偏把营地搭在火山口边上。他毕生研究世界各地的活火山和深洞，1948年在刚果基伍湖观察新火山基图罗，甚至爬进火山口拍照、测温。
goals: 辨析 can/could、be able to 与 manage to 的差别
理解一般过去时与现在完成时的分工：1948 年的考察用过去时，毕生成就用现在完成时
学会 set up、observe、take photographs、risk one's life、for long、close to 等表达
lead.summary: 课文记述塔捷耶夫的一次考察：1948 年他在刚果基伍湖观察新火山基图罗，趁火山猛烈喷发把营地搭在近旁抢拍照片；岩浆眼看合围，他及时逃脱；两天后他又爬进火山口拍照测温。语法重点：过去某次成功做到用 was able to 或 managed to，不用 could。
lead.tips: could 只说明“有能力”，不说明“已做到”；alive 作定语必须后置（any man alive）；for long 多用于否定句。

exercises.q: 根据汉语提示填空：The volcano was ______ ______ (猛烈喷发), and a river of ______ (液态的) rock was coming towards him.
汉译英：1948 年他去了刚果的基伍湖，去观察一座新火山并拍了一些精彩的照片。
exercises.a: In 1948, he went to Lake Kivu in the Congo to observe a new volcano and took a number of brilliant photographs.
exercises.note: a number of 后接复数名词。

exercises.q: 汉译英：他把营地搭在离正在猛烈喷发的火山非常近的地方。
exercises.a: He set up his camp very close to the volcano while it was erupting violently.
exercises.note: set up 搭建；close to 靠近。

exercises.q: 用 manage to 改写：He took a number of brilliant photographs.
exercises.a: He managed to take a number of brilliant photographs.

exercises.q: 汉译英：塔捷耶夫经常这样冒着生命危险。
exercises.a: Tazieff has often risked his life in this way.

exercises.q: 用括号内动词的正确形式填空：He ______ (wait) until it became quiet and ______ (return) two days later. The liquid rock threatened to surround him, but he ______ (manage) to escape just in time.
汉译英：他能告诉我们的有关活火山的情况比任何在世的人都要多。
exercises.a: He has been able to tell us more about active volcanoes than any man alive.

quiz.q: 要表达“他终于设法把门打开了”（强调费了很大劲才做成），应选哪句？
options: He tried to open the door.
He managed to open the door.
He was able to opening the door.
quiz.note: manage to 强调克服困难后做成。

quiz.q: “他把帐篷搭在离火山非常近的地方”，正确的英文表达是？
options: He set up his camp very close to the volcano.
He set up his camp very close with the volcano.
He set up his camp very closely the volcano.
He set his camp very near to the volcano.

quiz.q: 课文中“一股岩浆”的表达是哪一项？
哪一项填入句子最恰当：He waited until the volcano became quiet and he ______ return two days later.
quiz.note: was able to 表过去某次成功。

quiz.q: “任何在世的人”的正确英文是？
课文原句“塔捷耶夫经常冒这样的生命危险”是？
options: Tazieff has often risked his life in this way.
Tazieff often risks his life in this way.
Tazieff had often risked his life in this way.
Tazieff was often risking his life in this way.
